units.source_text: [\[25\]](#part1333.html#w25) 太政大臣藤原忠平暗夜在紫宸殿（即南殿）的御帐后面走过，

en.t: In the dark of night, the Chancellor Fujiwara no Tadahira passed behind the imperial curtain in the Shishinden, that is, the South Hall,

units.source_text: 有鬼握住了他的佩刀的鞘尾，

en.t: when a demon seized the end of the scabbard of the sword he was wearing,
so he drew the sword and struck at the demon,
and the demon fled toward the northeast.

units.source_text: 事见历史故事《大镜》所载。

en.t: This incident is recorded in the historical tale The Great Mirror.
